description: This file contains unit tests for the DrugOrder class, verifying its cloning, copying, comparison, dosing, and orderability logic within the OpenMRS healthcare system.

classes.name: DrugOrderTest
classes.description: Contains JUnit test methods for verifying the behavior of the DrugOrder class such as cloning, copying, and orderable comparisons.

methods.name: cloneForDiscontinuing_shouldSetAllTheRelevantFields
methods.description: Tests that the cloneForDiscontinuing method correctly clones relevant fields and sets the order action to DISCONTINUE.

methods.name: copy_shouldCopyAllDrugOrderFields
methods.description: Tests that the copy method duplicates all fields of a DrugOrder.

methods.name: cloneForRevision_shouldSetAllTheRelevantFields
methods.description: Verifies that cloneForRevision clones the order with proper field values, especially in the context of ADC order revisions.

methods.name: cloneForRevision_shouldSetTheRelevantFieldsForADCOrder
methods.description: Specific test for ADC orders that checks the cloning process preserves relevant fields and clears certain auto-generated fields.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnFalseIfTheOtherOrderIsNull
methods.description: Checks that the method correctly returns false when comparing with null.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnFalseIfTheOtherOrderIsNotADrugOrder
methods.description: Verifies method returns false if the compared order is not a DrugOrder instance.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnFalseIfBothDrugsAreNullAndTheConceptsAreDifferent
methods.description: Checks that differing concepts with null drugs result in false.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnFalseIfTheConceptsMatchAndOnlyThisHasADrug
methods.description: Verifies that if only the current order has a drug but concepts are same, returns false.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnFalseIfTheConceptsMatchAndOnlyTheOtherHasADrug
methods.description: Verifies that if only the other order has a drug, and concepts match, returns false.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnFalseIfTheConceptsMatchAndDrugsAreDifferentAndNotNull
methods.description: Checks that different drugs with same concept result in false.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnTrueIfBothDrugsAreNullAndTheConceptsMatch
methods.description: Returns true if both orders have null drugs and matching concepts.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnTrueIfTheDrugsMatch
methods.description: Returns true if both orders reference the same drug.

methods.name: shouldSetDefaultDosingTypeToFreeText
methods.description: Checks that a new DrugOrder defaults to SimpleDosingInstructions type.

methods.name: shouldAllowToSetCustomDosingTypes
methods.description: Verifies that the dosing type can be customized with a different DosingInstructions subclass.

methods.name: setAutoExpireDateBasedOnDuration_shouldDelegateCalculationToDosingInstructions
methods.description: Tests that setAutoExpireDateBasedOnDuration delegates to the DosingInstructions instance.

methods.name: setAutoExpireDateBasedOnDuration_shouldNotCalculateForDiscontinueAction
methods.description: Ensures auto-expire date isn't recalculated if the action is DISCONTINUE.

methods.name: setAutoExpireDateBasedOnDuration_shouldNotCalculateIfAutoExpireDateAlreadySet
methods.description: Checks that the auto-expire date isn't recalculated if already set.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnTrueIfTheConceptsMatchAndHaveSameDrugNonCoded
methods.description: Verifies order comparison with same concept and similar drug non-coded string ignoring case.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnFalseIfTheConceptsMatchAndHaveDifferentDrugNonCoded
methods.description: Tests that different drug non-coded strings with same concept return false.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnTrueIfTheConceptsMatchAndHaveSameDrugNonCodedTrimmingSpaces
methods.description: Checks similarity with drugNonCoded strings differing only in whitespace.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnFalseIfTheConceptsMatchAndEitherOfDrugNonCodedIsNull
methods.description: Verifies false if one order has null drugNonCoded.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnTrueIfTheConceptsMatchAndBothDrugNonCodedIsNull
methods.description: Verifies true if both orders have null drugNonCoded and matching concepts.
